literal: Firmness of action is called a person's firmness of mind; other all are different.
translation: What is called firmness in action is simply a person's firmness of mind. All other things are secondary.
modern: ஒரு செயலைச் செய்து முடிக்கும் உறுதி என்பது ஒருவனுடைய மன உறுதியே ஆகும்; மற்றவை எல்லாம் அதற்கு ஈடாகாத வேறுபட்டவைகளே.
explanation: This couplet defines what it truly means to be resolute in one's actions. The phrase 'வினைத்திட்பம்' (firmness of action) is directly equated to 'மனத்திட்பம்' (firmness of mind), showing that outward success relies entirely on inner conviction. The word 'பிற' (other or different) is used here to mean that all other resources or advantages are secondary and belong to a different, lesser category. Thus, true strength in any undertaking comes from mental resolve rather than external factors.
